balls.text: a swat over extra cover! Jitesh ends on 32* off just 15 balls. He made room early, and Reddy went short and wide of off. Jitesh clubbed it through the line to bag six more, and ruin Reddy's day further
whammed over deep square leg! Don't ask me what that first word means, though. Another full toss just below his waist, and swiped across for a big six
wide for extra bounce! This is too high, even as Jitesh is across the stumps to try and hook a short ball
right between long-on and deep midwicket! He charged down the pitch, and converted the ball into a full toss to heave across the line and in the gap
shorter side of a length outside off, and pulled to a straightish fine leg
ohh, he tries the reverse scoop but is beaten. On a short of a length around sixth stump, and Shivam seemed to have little clue of the length or the bounce there
short delivery outside off, and pulled to deep backward square. Jitesh collided with Reddy while running, given he was looking at the ball
pulled aerially, and the ball lands at where an imaginary square leg would have been. Sharp short ball from Natarajan, and pulled off the top half of the bat by Jitesh
slower ball, and on a short of a length which shapes away to end on sixth stump. He went ramping, but missed
now he sweeps this much-fuller ball on off to deep midwicket. There is a throw at the non-striker's end, but the bails are whipped off after Sanvir has dived
swatted over extra cover! Natarajan angled this length ball across, as it ended just outside off. Jitesh slammed that back forcefully to bag four
short of a length outside off, and pulled to deep square

ahh, well taken by Sanvir! He was placed at extra cover, and turned halfway around. Then he back-pedalled and took a reverse-cupped catch, as Ashutosh had lofted this offcutter from Natarajan, who bowled on a length on middle. PBKS losing steam here
bowls full and outside leg, as Ashutosh looks to swipe but misses. Wide called
change of pace, and short and wide of off. Jitesh swats this to deep extra cover after playing late
slower ball, and on the shorter side of a length on top of off. Stabbed towards point
quite full and just outside off. Driven to mid-off for a rapid single
short of a length outside off, and punched towards deep point

a full toss results in a wicket! Cummins angles this in, and bowled a lowish full toss on middle and off. Rossouw went slogging, but the ball was at 140kph, and found long-on, who took the catch after a few steps forward
bowls a slower ball which is fullish and pretty wide of off. Swung away over the bowler's head with a flat bat
ahh, nicely bowled again! Another yorker angling in and ending on middle, as it is clipped to deep square
more full tosses, and this is slightly higher on off. Pushed to cover
another yorker which swings in and ends on middle. Whipped just wide of long-on for two
full toss angling across and finishing around sixth stump. Swiped to long-on
ahh, an inswinging very full ball middle and on off. Driven to long-off
a low full toss on the stumps, and whipped to deep square

slower ball, and full around sixth stump. Nudged to midwicket after getting across, as Reddy himself gives the chase. And, and... Shashank is run-out! There was a call for two runs between the batters, and Rossouw took off for the second immediately. Shashank hesitated for a few seconds for the second run, before realising that Rossouw was at his end already. So he still took a few steps down, but ended well short of the throw at the keeper's end
short of a length, and angled into middle. Pulled to short fine after getting across
short of a length on off, and he rides the bounce to pull to deep square
swats this length ball wide of long-off! He comes charging down the pitch, and crashes this length ball around off to beat long-off
ahh, Rossouw tries to distract the bowler, who bowls a slower ball wide of off. Left alone
tonked wide log-on! On a friendly length outside off, and he has a complete, free swing of the bat to dispatch that
short of a length around off, and gets good bounce. Pulled wide of long-on
appeal for lbw, but turned down. Cummins doesn't review either. This was turning away from him, as Rossouw was beaten while looking to push forward. But it seemed to be pitch outside leg
pulled over midwicket! Short of a length on the stumps, and gets his front leg out of the way to dump that for another six
clips this off his pads towards midwicket
jumps out, and blocks this ball turning away towards off

ahh, very agile from Klaasen! It is given out, but Prabh reviews. This is what happened: Prabh had made a lot of room early, and so Viyaskanth went on a length way outside leg. Prabh went swinging for the leg side, but missed. The ball went below his gloves, though, and as it seemed to be headed down the pitch, Klaasen did well to grab it single-handedly. Replays confirm that there was a little tickle off the gloves, as he was swinging his arms to attack that ball
full and slow on middle, and turns away, as Prabh looks to heave but is beaten
drags this length ball, which is wide of off, to extra cover
short of a length around leg, as Prabh comes down the pitch and punches to mid-off
a short ball outside off at a change of pace, as Rossouw pulls to deep square
good ball! He goes for the yorker on off, and Prabh can squeeze it to only mid-off
whips this fullish ball swinging in to fine leg
bang! Six over long-on! Hoicks at this length ball angling into him and finishing on fifth stump, even as it seemed to have come from the inside half of the bat
a slower bouncer, and wide called. He banged it in short on middle, and the ball jumped up, even as Rossouw hardly moved after letting the ball go over him
ahh, well bowled! It is an inswinging yorker at 140kph on middle, and is clipped to deep square
pulled wide of long-on! He reads the slower ball well, as it is on a length just outside off. He waits for it, and clubs it away in the gap
a full toss again, and this is on off. Bashed to deep point
another scoop past short fine leg! Again he gets across the stumps already, and sees a short ball which is wide of off. He ramps it back just the right of the fielder
bowls a slower ball, on a length around seventh stump. Slashed on the bounce to point
angles this in, and bowls a full toss around middle and leg. Swung away to deep square
backs away, and pushes this length ball angling across towards off to long-off
makes room and skips down. He jams this very full ball outside off towards cover
gets across, and pulls over short fine leg! He exposed all his stumps early, and Reddy bowled short and around sixth stump. Prabh was set for the shot already, and sent it flaying
change of pace again - rather, the usual pace, I'd say - as he bowls fullish on leg. Clipped to deep square
swiped over deep backward square leg! Short of a length delivery on off, and angling away, as Rossouw pulls hard for a six over the longer side
swatted over midwicket! Slower delivery again, but this is short and around sixth stump. Rossouw waits for the ball to come, and gets on top of it, before swatting it away
starts with a slower ball, which he bowls fullish and a bit wide of off. Left alone by Rossouw, but not called wide. However, it is a no-ball, though
goes swinging at this ball, but is beaten on the outside edge. There is half an appeal for caught behind
walloped over long-on! He throws everything he has, and bashes this length ball which is dipping on a stump-to-stump line
on a length on middle and leg, with a hint of turn away. Pushed towards long-on, and they nab two to raise Prabh's fifty
this is full and straight, and slower too. Defended back to the bowler
full and flat on off, and stabbed behind point
tosses it up, and dips it on a full length on his pads. Flicked to deep square, before Rossouw sends Prabh back
on a length just outside off, and the ball seemed to stay a bit low too. He went pulling, but missed
chips this shortish ball around sixth stump to deep midwicket, as he uses his wrists to clip it aerially
short of a length just outside off, and tennis-batted back off the bottom edge to the bowler
ahh, he squats down and tries to slash this short-of-a-length ball finishing wide-ish of off after angling away, but finds the point fielder
angled in, and pretty full on middle and off. Pushed to long-on with the swing

taken at point! Natarajan bowled short and wide of off, even as Taide seemed to walk down the pitch. He went ahead with the slash seeing the room that was available, but ended up slashing straight to the fielder, as the ball travelled rapidly
nudges this off his pads to deep midwicket to keep ticking
lofted over the bowler's head! Full and tossed up, and dipping on middle, as he presents the full face of the bat to bag four more
shorter side of a length on middle and leg, and whipped to deep square
much fuller and just outside leg, as he looks to tickle but gets it off his pad. Two runs past short fine leg
pumped over deep midwicket! Short of a length on middle and off, and Prabh shifts his weight back to slam this deep over the bigger boundary
ohh, almost skips down and then opens his stance up in Dhawan style, before clipping a length ball on middle and leg to deep midwicket
again bowls short, but this is on the stumps, and slower too. Pulled to deep midwicket, as he loses his bottom hand
short of a length, and a wide line outside off. Swatted to cover
ahh, on a length on middle and leg, and slower too, as it straightens away. Nudged away to deep square
on a length, and just outside off, so there's no room this time. Slashed to deep backward point
rammed over wide long-on! Skips down the pitch, and rams this length ball on the stumps to go through the line for six
Taide switches over early, and reverse lofts this length ball which is wide of off, and straightens in. The ball lobs over short third

ohh, great work by deep midwicket! It is Reddy there, as he moves to his right and parries the ball back almost last moment. It was bowled full and on the stumps, as Prabh slog swept between deep midwicket and deep backward square
ahh, very short on the stumps, and quicker too. Slashed to point
taps at this length ball turning away towards off, and sends Taide back
lofts this slower ball on a full length just outside off, and goes bang over the bowler's head to bisect long-off and long-on! The bat face seemed to have closed, but the ball still travelled
on a length, and around sixth stump. Flashed to deep extra cover
full ball outside leg, and tickled to short fine leg's right
heaved over wide long-on! He gets his front leg out of the way, and clubs this length ball around a stump-to-stump line to smash it across the line
good bowling! He sees Prabh jumping out early, and fires in an inswinging yorker. Prabh jams the ball down outside leg, and they pinch a single as the ball rolls away to the leg side
steps across, and gets a lowish full toss angling into middle and leg. Clipped to deep square
swatted to mid-off's right! Bhuvi bowls a slower ball on a short of a length around sixth stump, and Prabh skips down to hammer it back
on a length on leg, and at only 115kph. He swipes but gets it off his hips towards short fine leg
look to step down and pull this short-of-a-length ball, but gets a bottom edge to the keeper
whipped superbly over fine leg! Cummins is left wondering. He went much fuller this time, angling it in, but this one ended up on his pads. Prabh went through the line, and dispatched the ball
gets across, and pulls over midwicket! Short of a length around fifth stump, as Cummins attempts a slower-ball bouncer. But Prabh waits before riding the bounce and pulling hard
drives at this length ball angled into off, as the ball races away to mid-off, but they still pinch a single
much fuller length on off, and dragged to mid-off
short delivery around middle and off, and he sways out of the way. Wide called, but Cummins reviews. It is overturned, though, as it is not quite passing close to the wide line
bowls a low full toss which is angling into middle, and is clipped to deep square leg
over short fine leg! Natarajan pulls his length back to go on a short of a length outside off, and Taide pulls, but gets a top edge over the fielder
drilled between the non-striker and the stumps! He plays that with a flat bat, as the ball is on a length around fifth stump, with Taide nearly swiping at it
now the length is really full on his pads, and is whipped to deep square
ohh, nicely bowled! Prabh backed away early, and Natarajan bowled it short and outside leg. He went to pull but the ball went over his bat
short of a length just outside off, and hacked to deep third after playing a bit late
bowls on a length while angling it across from over the wicket, and the ball finishes around off. Dabbed to point for another hurried single
quick single! Just taps this length ball around off towards cover, and they take off
short of a length this time, but Prabh pulls this over mid-on! The ball arrives only around his waist, and he waits before clubbing it away neatly

ahh, fortunate four runs! He gave himself room and had a bit of a heave at this yorker-length ball which was angling in, and arrived wide of leg. But because he was away from the stumps, the ball took the bottom edge to trickle away
chips this to the bowler's left, and the ball just evades Bhuvi! Length delivery shaping away towards off, as Taide nudged it back towards mid-on
pushes forward at this fuller ball angling away towards off, and the ball dribbles towards mid-off
clips this off a length on middle and off, and the ball goes rolling past the square-leg fielder's left. Two for Taide
short of a length, as he comes out jumping again. Swatted to mid-off after making room
a little appeal for lbw by Cummins, but this seemed to be heading down the leg side. Full delivery angling in, as Prabhsimran looked to flick but missed
short of a length and angling across towards off. Slashed to deep third
again drives forward, but this time towards Cummins himself, as the ball is on a length, but more on middle and leg
driven down the ground! He presents the full face of the bat at this length ball on off, and just leans to play forward between the stumps and non-striker

ahh, good work by the man at deep point! He runs to his right and tumbles to pull the ball back, as Taide drives at this length ball angling across and finishing around fifth stump. He drove off the outside half of the bat
fuller length, and angling into middle and leg. Dabbed down to the on side
woah, bashed past Bhuvi! He had shown the intent earlier this over, and again jumps down this time to slam back a knuckle ball on a length on sixth stump
this one straightens off a length on middle and off, with Bhuvi angling it in. Nudged back to the bowler
now he leans forward at this length delivery in the channel, and pushes to mid-off with a slightly closed face of the bat
walks down a step, and Bhuvi goes short around sixth stump. He goes chopping, but gets a bottom edge, because the line didn't seem wide enough
angling across, and landing on the fuller side of a length on off. Dabbed behind point to get going
Short, wide - hacked down the ground for victory! What were you worried about? Sunrisers notch a big win heading into the qualifiers.
Steps down, swings through the ball but was looking for a boundary rather than the fielder at wide long off
Sanvir gives himself room to try and carve through the off side but can't breach the ring
Another arm ball from Brar off a length, another single taken down the ground
Skidding into the body, worked awkwardly but effectively down to long on

Bowled him! Klaasen decides now is the time for some touch play and attempts to ramp Brar's straight delivery. The field had changed to get him to do something different - man up on the 45, with both straight fielders set back - and he does just that. Alas, he gets nothing on the ball and watches on in horror his stumps light up
An ungainly hack from Samad to this arm ball, but he'll take the single into the leg side
Another skiddy googly, worked down the ground for a single to keep the strike
Charges and goes big down the ground! Powerful strike with exceptional use of the feet to get him to the pitch of a length delivery.
Cut hard, but straight to backward point
Lovely googly... almost finds the stumps but Klaasen's big bat squeezes it away off the inside edge
Flatter, shorter, spinning off the track into leg stump, met with the full face to get a single into midwicket
Thick edge squirts out to point as Samad is done by a leggie
Off the mark immediately, tucking one into midwicket as he steps across to a length delivery just outside off stump
An unconvincing knock comes to an end! It's needed an excellent catch from Shashank, who does brilliantly to take it low at cover, diving forward to his right to claim.
Length, top off off, played off the inside half of the bat but with enough force to find a single at midwicket
Another bumper to Klaasen, and a second that's a little too high
Driven on the up as Arshdeep goes back to over the wicket. This time Shashank gets right behind the ball!
That's got through! Around the wicket from Arshdeep, punched off the back foot with so much power that it does for the fielder at extra cover

Another glorious drive from Klaasen, waiting for this full ball across him before timing sweetly. The fielder at cover dives to get a finger on the ball which slows it down enough for Rossouw to tidy up about 10 yards before the boundary
In to the batter from around the wicket, with some late movement too. Shahbaz watches it all the way, digging out a drive but straight to mid off
Wide of the crease, glorious on drive from Klaasen but well cut off by Rossouw at a very straight long on
Wide, short once more but pace off, punched into the covers. It looks like Shashank Singh has done well to scoop that before the sponge but his spikes have grazed it at the point of contact!
This one's too short and is signalled accordingly...
Good follow-up, sharp, skidding off the surface and into Klaasen, who squeezes it out back to the bowler
Wide of the crease, fired through short and nails the keeper's gloves. Klaasen ducked as he went for the pull shot there. Good ball
Short, lifted over the ring but the fielder running around from deep cover keeps it to one
Attempted inswinger yorker is a low full toss, clipped out to wide long on
Cramps him for room once more but is a touch fuller allowing Klaasen to short-arm this away in front of square to get off strike
Beats Klaasen with a short delivery... but the under edge scuttles away beyond the keeper for a couple. Decent pace and line from Arshdeep, straight at Klaasen's noggin

Oh no! Harshal Patel, what have you done... an absolute dolly at deep square leg. Swung high by Shahbaz but by no means a clean collection. Should have been taken. Arshdeep is understandably perplexed as he hits his thigh in frustration.
Back of a length, decking into the left-handed Shahbaz, who loses the ball as it looks up into the off side after clattering into his front hip
Full, decked across from over the wicket, punched out to deep cover

Too little too late? Wide slower ball drews a full-blooded thwack from Nitish. It's the width that has done for the right-hander, who ends up scything high to the fielder running to his left from deep point
Full, moving in late, watched well by Klaasen who guides it down the ground to long off
Jumps wide, sends down a leg cutter, dug out behind point
Straighter from Harshal, punched out to long off
Crisp and clean! Wide of off stump, full of a length, and punched with ease by Klaasen, too powerfully for the man in the ring at cover

Great running! Off a length, skidding into Klaasen who works to midwicket and immediately sprints off looking for two. Nitish stutters for a moment before setting off for that second and puts in a dive to make his ground. A direct hit would have been close but excellent work from these two
Heaved to long on... and six! There was a fielder under that one, but enough minerals behind that strike as Harpreet goes full again. Nitish's hands were just too quick
Good comeback from Harpreet, sharper, fuller, into middle and leg, pushed inside-out into the covers for one
Wow! It's not a short or length ball, but Klaasen has rocked onto the back foot and smashed it down the ground for a huge six!
Sharper, spitting off the deck and forcing Klaasen just to bunt it to the leg side
Length, on with the arm. Klaasen rocks back to cut but can only hit it back to the bowler
Skips down the track as Harpeet tries to cramp him for room. Ends up hitting his pads and squirting to point for one
The big man is here! Chahar goes through and over but Klaasen doesn't care - rocks back to smash length into the stands at midwicket.
Punched into the covers
Looped full but wide of the tramline
Reverse and four! A little lucky with swish of the bat as the ball goes a lot finer than was intended, but another boundary to Nitish
Short, wide but doesn't get up meaning Nitish has to crouch to cut and can't beat point
Bang! A quicker, short length delivery is smashed Into the second tier! Great transfer of weight onto the back foot before going through with the short
Leading edge from Klaasen as he tries to work a full leg spinner into midwicket, but is able to get a single at least into the covers
Gorgeous straight drive from Klaasen as Shashank digs this one just full of a good length
Scuffed down the ground as Nitish tries to impart a bit of pace into a slower delivery
Short, into Klaasen's body, swivelled away to deep fine leg
Angled into the pads, a thick inside edge saves Nitish and allows him to pocket a single as the ball dribbles towards point
Good length, straight, punched down to long on to get off the mark
What an introduction! Shashank strikes with his first delivery, starting with a wide slower ball which is sliced him into the covers where Shivam Singh is lurking to take the catch. Now then...
Good strike - a checked bunt to midwicket - but straight to the man out there. Abhishek to retain the strike. And why not - he is looking imperious
No chance for the fielder with that one! Harpreet drags his length back and Abhishek meets it more than half way before smearing it over wide long on!
Full... straight.... and just over the fence! Down the ground where Chahar was making up ground from long on but beats him
Another stifled appeal as Abhishek tries to heave down the ground but a hint of an inside edge there
Oooof no good, no good at all! Very full but very wide and beats batter and keeper. On reflection, was he going for the leg side stumping expecting Abhishek to charge? I think he was you know...
Down the track but almost yorks himself as he digs a single out to long on
Starts around the wicket with a muted LBW appeal as the ball goes on with the arm. Alas, it was sliding down
Another googly, fuller than the previous one in the over, cut straight to point fielder in the ring
Pushed out into the covers

What a catch.... oh no! Full, on the toes, smashed to Shashank at long on who takes the catch, goes to throw the ball in the air to relay it to himself but accidentally lobs it over the rope to himself instead
Googly across the leftie, but short enough to allow him to play it off the pitch and punch a single through cover
Slightly shorter, turn into middle, worked into the covers
Glorious drive as Charar goes full outside off but brilliantly fielding out at deep cover by Harshal Patel drags the ball back in before he makes contact with the sponge

Checked straight drive brings up Abhishek's third half-century of the season! Full, straightly, played with a straight bat on the full volley to lob it down the ground. That's a half-century from 21 deliveries.
Full-ish, wide, brilliantly timed by Abhishek! Waited on it, and sliced expertly behind point to split the two fielders out on the fence
Pace off, worked to the leg side
Stunning fielding! Driven gloriously and a full length dive to his left from Shivam Singh saves a certain four. Almost gets the run out at the striker's end, too!
Test match length and line, into the top of off, worked away for a single into mid on
Tucked into midwicket once more and that's an excellent start from Charar
Short, hacked into the leg side but the contact is so poor that it falls well short of the two fielders in the deep
Shorter and sharper, allowing the right-hander to use the pace to find a single into midwicket
Straighter, full and a bit of bounce resulting in Nitish taking his bottom hand off the back as he defends into the leg side
Length, skidding off the track just outside off stump, pushed out to point
First sight of Chahar, who is over the wicket to the leftie. Short, googly to start, which Abhishek meets down the track and swipes away into midwicket
Nice get-out from Dhawan, full, wide, forcing Abhishek to reach and meet it on the full and take the single out into the covers
Slower ball... read like a book! Abhishek reads the cutter, hangs back and swings it away for an 82m six over long on
Wide, length, but dug into the pitch. Nitish tries to carve beyond deep point but has to settle for a single due to a lack of timing
Full ball, punched down the ground for a single
Ooooooooo almost a run out at the nonstriker's end! Crisp drive off the back foot races to Arshdeep at mid off. Nitish had made his ground though with some good acceleration
Slower, floated full outside off. Abhishek waits but can't impart his usual malice on the ball, fielded by that deep cover fielder
Very wide down the off side. Bowl it again, Dhawan

Number 23 for Harshal Patel! A choatic over ends with a slower ball deceiving Tripathi. His attempt to smoke this right down the ground results in a skyer for Arshdeep at third, who watches it well to take the catch
High into the off side, but over the fielders as Tripathi gets his line right
Fired wide of the mark on the off side so we've got another freebie
Extraordinary! Tripathi's already crouching for the ramp when Harshal bowls a full toss and he manages to contort his body to flick it squarer over the fence on the leg side... Free Hit incoming...
Cleaner strike to the same region but the fielder now in position meets it after a couple of bounces
Inside out over cover! Bit of a jive to the leg side and full extension of the arms. Not quite out of the middle but he picked the length perfectly there
Nowhere near where he intended... but they all count! Abhishek swings hard at this length delivery, attempting to clear the leg side fence but ends up getting it all the way over deep third
He's listening, DC - dabbing this one behind point
Another heaved over fine leg! A repeat of the six from the previous over as Dhawan fails to get out of the over
Slower ball, just inside the lines on the off side. Abhishek tries to reach for it but has moved too far to the leg side to get anything on it
High... fine.... and safe! Three Punjab fielders converge and Patel gets to the ball first to prevent it from bouncing over the sponge. Good fielding in the end
Wide, scuffed off the toe but straight to third who is up in the circle
Fired down the leg side and away to the fine leg boundary! The initial call of five wides gets reviewed and it turns out there's a spike next to Tripathi's pad so it goes down as leg byes
Wide, cut hard but straight to the backward point on the bounce. Missed out there - either side of the fielder and it would have been a boundary
That's the one Abhishek wanted! Similar to the earlier four swung away to midwicket, but this time the full swing and a little hop backs allows him to get it high and over fine leg
Tries to give himself room as Arshdeep goes shorter and just outside off, but finds nothing but air
Gets hold of this one! Short of a length, into the left-hander's arc as he stands tall and swings it away to midwicket
And again, this time Abhishek tries to smash the white off the ball as the left-armer laces this one with a pleasing amount of away swing
Play and a miss outside off
Short, edged... and all the way to the fence! Arshdeep does the batter for pace, but the bumper races away behind the keeper for four
Change of line but the same result! Wide of off and guided neatly backward of point
Timing! Full and picked up beautifully through midwicket! More of a drive than a flick
First of the chase! Boomed down the ground, holding the pose. Less pace on this one from Dhawan and comes back with interest!
Charges, swings but misses completely as Dhawan goes wider and brings his length back after spying Tripathi was keen to get down the track
Off the mark with a neat tuck to midwicket as Dhawan gets one to lift a touch, met just above middle and off
Good length but wide allowing Tripathi to throw his hands through the ball out to the man at deep point
Stifled LBW appeal as Arshdeep is full, into the pads of Tripathi, but sliding down as it cannons away into square leg
Straighter this time, defended into the covers before a loud "No!" from Tripathi
Over the cordon! Length, wide and allows the right-hander to guide over the slips to the vacant third for his second boundary
Shorter, into the body, fended into the leg side
Just a push opening the face, meeting a full inswinger through cover point with a block-drive
How about that for a perfect start?! Gorgeous seam, glorious arc, top of off clipped and Head goes for a golden duck!
